meaning:
1) yesterday, recently, formerly
1a) yesterday
1b) formerly (fig.)
1c) from yesterday, already (in phrase)
2) (TWOT +) before, before that time, before the time, heretofore, of late, of old, these days, time(s) past

renderings.kjv: for there hath not been such a thing heretofore

elsewhere.note: The Philistines were afraid, for they said, “God has come into the camp.” They said, “Woe to us! For there has not been such a thing before.
In times past, when Saul was king over us, it was you who led Israel out and in. Yahweh said to you, ‘You will be shepherd of my people Israel, and you will be…
For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.
For his burning place has long been ready. Yes, for the king it is prepared. He has made its pyre deep and large with fire and much wood. Yahweh’s breath, like…
But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.
